title: Island Workspace
description: A studio workspace with navigation on a shared canvas and raised islands for the next milestone, review activity, active projects and recent updates.
summary: A quiet sidebar, raised panels and a milestone brief for a studio dashboard.
notes: The sidebar and workspace share a canvas. At narrower container widths the same section links move above the content, and the four panels eventually stack in reading order. The workspace scrolls with the page.
The milestone brief uses native dialog invoker commands (show-modal and request-close). The button needs browser support for command and commandfor. Escape also closes the open dialog.
The brief, review counts, project progress and activity are sample data. When updating the chart, keep each label and --ab-island-count in sync and set --ab-island-chart-max to the top of the scale.
